title: Level-of-Detail Pyramids of A5 Cells for Browser Rendering
text: s2_santiago, a5view, holds 15,626 resolution-18 cells (22 m across) cloud-free Sentinel-2 mosaic Santiago, Chile, blue, green, red near-infrared bands. writes pyramid representative leaf bands, coarse cell keeps colour real pixel rather blend, mean NDVI. Every coarser level groups leaves cell containing centres, level partitions data ncell counts leaves cell. browser opening file reads footer , 11 KB, tiles draws. a5_read_pyramid() reads levels way:
code: library(a5pyramid)  santiago <- a5view::s2_santiago santiago$ndvi <- with(santiago, (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04))  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".parquet") a5_write_pyramid(   santiago, path,   aggregate = "rep_child",   reducers = c(ndvi = "mean"),   types = c(B02 = "uint16", B03 = "uint16", B04 = "uint16", B08 = "uint16", ndvi = "float32") ) info <- a5_pyramid_info(path) info #> ── a5pyramid file 'filec01de20b7c3ad.parquet' ────────────────────────────────── #> Size: 380.3 KB (footer 10.8 KB) #> A5 index: 1.0 #> Leaves: resolution 18, 15,626 cells #> LODs: 2-18 (17 levels) #> Rows: 21,077 #> Tiles: 22 row groups (tile size 4096) #> Columns: B02 <uint16, rep_child>, B03 <uint16, rep_child>, B04 <uint16, #> rep_child>, B08 <uint16, rep_child>, ndvi <float32, mean> #> Bbox: -70.6722, -33.4801, -70.6418, -33.4549 #> Written by: a5pyramid 0.0.0.9000, a5 crate 1.0.0 library(ggplot2)  levels <- a5_read_pyramid(path, lod = c(14, 16, 18)) ggplot(levels, aes(cell = cell, fill = a5view::cells_rgb(B04, B03, B02, range = c(300, 2800)))) +   a5view::geom_a5() +   facet_wrap(~ paste("LOD", lod)) +   theme_void()

title: Write a level-of-detail pyramid of A5 cells to Parquet — a5_write_pyramid
code: library(a5R) centre <- a5_lonlat_to_cell(-3.19, 55.95, resolution = 10) cells <- a5_uncompact(a5_spherical_cap(centre, 3000), resolution = 15) x <- data.frame(cell = cells, value = runif(length(cells)))  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".parquet") a5_write_pyramid(x, path, types = c(value = "float32"), tile_size = 1000) a5_pyramid_info(path) #> ── a5pyramid file file29306eb17f9b.parquet ───────────────────────────────────── #> Size: 13.2 KB (footer 4.8 KB) #> A5 index: 1.0 #> Leaves: resolution 15, 1,024 cells #> LODs: 2-15 (14 levels) #> Rows: 1,426 #> Tiles: 15 row groups (tile size 1000) #> Columns: value <float32, mean> #> Bbox: -3.2194, 55.9355, -3.127, 56.0338 #> Written by: a5pyramid 0.0.0.9000, a5 crate 1.0.0
